rows.query:
SELECT wal->>$5 as type,
       wal->>$6 as schema,
       wal->>$7 as table,
       COALESCE(wal->>$8, $9) as columns,
       COALESCE(wal->>$10, $11) as record,
       COALESCE(wal->>$12, $13) as old_record,
       wal->>$14 as commit_timestamp,
       subscription_ids,
       errors,
       slot_changes_count
FROM realtime.list_changes($1, $2, $3, $4)

select set_config('search_path', $1, true), set_config('role', $2, true), set_config('request.jwt.claims', $3, true), set_config('request.method', $4, true), set_config('request.path', $5, true), set_config('request.headers', $6, true), set_config('request.cookies', $7, true)
update cron.job_run_details set status = $1, return_message = $2, end_time = $3 where runid = $4
update cron.job_run_details set status = $1 where runid = $2
update cron.job_run_details set job_pid = $1, status = $2 where runid = $3
insert into cron.job_run_details (jobid, runid, database, username, command, status) values ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6)
update cron.job_run_details set status = $1, start_time = $2 where runid = $3
